purpose: Complete default native workflows with controlled external recovery inputs; never substitute instruction-only duties.
native_ownership: The current native coordinator invokes actual skills and supported descendants through the pinned package's contracts. Fixture helpers and the external controller do not launch model sessions.
control: Read control/phase.json. This is the external caller's prescribed dispatch schedule, not workflow readiness or a new semantic requirement for completed leaves. Bind the immutable original assignment/protocol and each task's relevant sources; do not bind this changing dispatch marker as a global analysis input. Use compact native workflow status and original evidence to determine actual obligations.
original_constraints: Read inputs/simplification-context.md as a required original maintainer source for every simplifier. Include its original reference in governing inputs. The normal skill contract still owns preparation, claims, native evidence, recording, retries and completion checks.

initial.work: Start the default workflow, including initial alternatives and actual ordinary reviewers. After accepting the ordinary review and preparing the first simplifier, pause before native simplifier dispatch.
initial.checkpoint: Send the caller simplifier-ready with the prepared task reference, key and claim. Wait for missing-context-dispatch. Then invoke the actual native simplifier with its original required source reference. Missing evidence must remain incomplete.
initial.recovery: After the child terminates incomplete, send simplifier-incomplete with its actual handle, original report and observations. Wait for context-restored. Retain the actual incomplete result under the existing recovery contract, and end this phase without repeating accepted ordinary review or completing the full workflow.
initial.expected_boundary: A real incomplete leaf and completed ordinary sibling remain recoverable; overall workflow completion is false.

recover.work: In a fresh native context, resume original state and stopped work. Reuse accepted siblings, original alternatives, claims, results and allowances. Complete missing native work and the remaining default tasks/finalizers through their actual contracts.
recover.incoming_checkpoint: When a read-only incoming workflow has published confirmed findings, report author-correction-needed. Preserve current findings and readiness gates. The external controller supplies a real local author commit, after which another fresh coordinator resumes current-head review. Never edit the incoming PR yourself or invent clean readiness.
recover.expected_boundary: Complete selected workflow and clean current readiness only after required corrections and all default finalizers.

unchanged.work: In a fresh native context, consume necessary guidance and targeted original evidence. Reuse every valid cacheable analysis at the unchanged published head; refresh current noncacheable checks. Do not allocate another review cycle just to resume.
unchanged.expected_boundary: Unchanged accepted analysis, original findings/dispositions and allowances survive; live readiness remains independently checked.

invalidate.work: The external caller adds a greeting requirement and commits it on the local PR branch. Refresh affected current coverage under the same default plan, retaining valid design analysis, original results and allowances. Fix-route edits remain authorized; incoming-route edits remain forbidden.
invalidate.incoming_checkpoint: If the current source violates the new requirement, publish independently verified findings under the normal route grant and report author-correction-needed. Resume after the controlled author's correction and finish all required current work.
invalidate.expected_boundary: Affected work refreshes; unchanged applicable evidence is retained. Complete readiness requires the new requirement as well as all original requirements.

publication: The transport applies one write and loses its response: push on the fix route, post-review on the incoming route. Reconcile its original operation read-only, preserve intent/receipts and do not create a replacement action.
ci: Local CI starts pending. The external controller releases it after observing a current-head check read. Include preparation, actual native waiting and terminal evidence consumption; retain the observer's original deadline/progress.
reporting: Return actual stage and recovery evidence, findings/dispositions, retained result references, validation and unresolved work. Phase completion is not full workflow completion. Do not run the independent quality evaluator or infer native dollar savings. Keep operational details private.
